final:
`public/models/helmet.glb` is written. It's 1.78 MB, down from 3.77 MB (53% smaller), and it needs no glTF extensions, so any glTF 2.0 viewer should load it.

- **Settings:** Old viewers can't read WebP, KTX2, meshopt, Draco or quantized geometry, because all of those need extensions. So I kept JPEG textures and unquantized geometry. The textures are still 2048px. JPEG quality is 60 for color maps and 80 for normal, metal/rough and occlusion maps.
- **Quality check:** The tool's fidelity score against the original is 0.942. Its recommended limit for no visible loss is 0.9. I haven't looked at the renders myself.
- **Other settings tried:**

| Texture size | JPEG quality (color / data) | File size | Fidelity |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2048px | 85 / 92 | 2.93 MB | 0.974 |
| 2048px | 70 / 85 | 2.06 MB | 0.953 |
| 1024px | 75 / 90 | 1.13 MB | 0.817 |
| 1024px | 70 / 85 | 1.02 MB | 0.798 |

  The 1024px versions fall below the limit, so I ruled them out.
- **Load and GPU memory:** I didn't measure load time for the final file. GPU memory is unchanged at 107 MiB, because the textures are still 2048px.
bash_cmds: node-assets optimize assets/helmet.glb -o public/models/helmet.glb --texture-format jpeg --texture-quality 85 --texture-data-quality 92 --geometry none --force; node-assets inspect public/models/helmet.glb --against assets/helmet.glb

for v in "70 85 2048" "75 90 1024" "70 85 1024"; do set -- $v; node-assets optimize assets/helmet.glb -o /tmp/h_$1_$3.glb --texture-format jpeg --texture-quality $1 --texture-data-quality $2 --texture-size $3 --geometry none --force >/dev/null; echo $v; node-assets inspect /tmp/h_$1_$3.glb --against assets/helmet.glb | grep -E "^bytes|fidelity:"; done

node-assets optimize assets/helmet.glb -o /tmp/h_60.glb --texture-format jpeg --texture-quality 60 --texture-data-quality 80 --geometry none --force >/dev/null; node-assets inspect /tmp/h_60.glb --against assets/helmet.glb | grep -E "^bytes|fidelity:"
cp /tmp/h_60.glb public/models/helmet.glb; node-assets inspect public/models/helmet.glb | head -8
